evidence: Refactors wallet internals by moving legacy wallet loading and migration routines into `wallet/legacy` and introducing `LegacyWallet`.
rationale: This refactor isolates obsolete legacy wallet loading and migration logic away from active descriptor wallet code. The author notes that co-mingling legacy code with descriptor code 'makes it difficult to implement new things into the wallet' and risks accidental calls to legacy routines. While beneficial for long-term codebase health and maintainability, it is an internal reorganization rather than a fix for user-facing defects or migration errors.
